title: Form of the ministry: word, sacraments, keys
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Third comes remitting sins toward ye repentant and binding ye unrepentant, which stands as called excommunication, whether generally in sermons or specially toward persons, so that people may be saved unto ye glory belonging toward God. — Second comes administering ye sacraments according toward Christ's institution; ministers stand as stewards belonging toward ye mysteries belonging toward God. — Ye form belonging toward ye ministry consists chiefly in three parts. First comes teaching and preaching ye word; hence ministers stand as teachers, ambassadors belonging toward God, and laborers in ye word.
pass_b_english: The form of the ministry consists chiefly in three parts. First comes teaching and preaching the word; hence ministers are teachers, ambassadors of God, and laborers in the word.
Second comes administering the sacraments according to Christ's institution; ministers are stewards of the mysteries of God.

Third comes remitting sins to the repentant and binding the unrepentant, which is called excommunication, whether generally in sermons or specially toward persons, so that people may be saved unto the glory of God.
source_text: Forma ministerii in tribus potissimum consistit: (1) in officio docendi et praedicandi verbum (Matt. 28:19; Mark 16:15)—hinc ministri doctores, legati Dei, operarii in verbo; (2) in officio administrandi sacramenta secundum Christi institutionem (Matt. 28:19)—dispensatores mysteriorum Dei (1 Cor. 4:1); (3) in officio remittendi peccata resipiscentibus ac ligandi non resipiscentes, quae dicitur excommunicatio (Matt. 18:18; 16:19), generatim in concionibus et speciatim ad singulas personas, fine ut in Dei gloriam homines serventur.
